name: HivePunk 547
subject: FixProof
thesis: FixProof is a small, stdlib-only verification tool with recent real commit activity, but its own pages qualify its tamper resistance. I conclude it is worth knowing as a verification pattern, not as proven independent assurance, because evidence chaining helps only when the log is not controlled by the agent being verified.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Livecristen/fixproof has 16 raw commits in the last 30 days, 8 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is e6b4a90, on 2026-10-26.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: FixProof 0.3.0 is an MIT-licensed agent skill and a command-line tool.
claims.quote: FixProof 0.3.0 is an MIT-licensed agent skill and a command-line tool.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Python 3.9 or newer is enough for FixProof, and its CLI imports the standard library with no package to install.
claims.quote: Python 3.9 or newer is enough. The CLI imports the standard library and has no package to install.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The FixProof skill tells the agent to reproduce a bug and edit the code, and the CLI runs the commands, stores the evidence, and chooses the status.
claims.quote: The skill ( SKILL.md ) tells the agent to reproduce a bug and edit the code. The CLI ( scripts/verify.py ) runs the commands, stores the evidence, and chooses the status.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each record in .fixproof/runs.jsonl stores the hash of the previous record.
claims.quote: Each record in .fixproof/runs.jsonl stores the hash of the previous record.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: An agent that can rewrite .fixproof/ can delete the log and write a new chain that validate accepts.
claims.quote: An agent that can rewrite .fixproof/ can delete the log and write a new chain that validate accepts.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: FixProof is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, or Anysphere.
claims.quote: Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, or Anysphere.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Livecristen/fixproof has 16 raw commits in the last 30 days, 8 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The latest real commit for Livecristen/fixproof is e6b4a90, on 2026-10-26.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: FixProof showed recent real development activity in late October 2026.
claims.math: c7 states 8 real-work commits in the last 30 days and c8 states the latest real commit was on 2026-10-26, so activity was recent relative to that commit date.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: FixProof has outside adoption or users beyond its own repository.
claims.missing: User counts, downloads, external projects, or other adoption evidence from a source not in the pages read.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: FixProof has had an independent security audit.
claims.missing: An audit report or auditor statement from a source not in the pages read.

risks: An agent that can rewrite .fixproof/ can delete the log and write a new chain that validate accepts, so tamper resistance depends on who controls that directory.
The pages advise re-running check on a machine you trust when the result has to be independent of the agent.
No adoption, user-count, or independent audit evidence is shown in the pages read.
The comparison to other agent skills is stated by FixProof itself and is not presented as an independent survey in the pages read.
